thread:
incident-bot: [PAGER] latency spike detected in prod-serving during release wave-4 (v2026.03.11). p95 from ~120ms -> ~1.8s, throughput down ~25%. Canary nodes logging kernel_fallback. Paging eng-oncall.

oncall-1: received the page, joining.

sam: i'm on it — which feature flip was in this wave?

oncall-1: fastpath-v2 was enabled 10m ago for wave-4.

cheng: looking at logs -> `kernel_selector: fallback to generic-kernel due to missing optimized-kernel for quantized-path` and batcher shows `microbatch_delay increased: 8ms -> 60ms`

cheng: logs snippet:
```
[6223456932] kernel_selector.cpp:214 select_kernel: optimized-kernel not found -> fallback
[6223456933] batcher.cpp:87 microbatch_delay=62ms queued=12
```

maria: CS reports multiple customer retries, small number of 5xxs on embeddings route. pinged top customers with initial note. :phone:

oncall-1: quick mitigation plan: 1) flip fastpath-v2 kill-switch, 2) if not enough, rollback wave-4, 3) throttle canary traffic / increase batching window to stabilize.

sam: flipping kill-switch now: `redwoodctl feature flip fastpath-v2 off --reason="latency regression"`

incident-bot: feature flip recorded by deploy-bot at 6223456950, change-id=chg_7a9b

cheng: after flip p95 dropped to ~200ms within 2m, kernel_fallback events reduced. Looks like selector is choosing an optimized path that mismatches quantized kernel, thrashing batching.

maria: CS: sent proactive message to affected customers with workaround and ETA.

customer-success: message sent to top 20 affected customers, included suggestion to retry after 5m.

oncall-1: marking as mitigated for now. we'll roll wave-4 back and pin previous rollout for 1h to be safe.

sre-lead: i'll enable temporary autoscale and bump batcher target window to 50ms for next 30m to smooth tail latency.

sam: initiating rollback: `deployctl rollback --wave=wave-4 --force --reason="post-flip latency regression"`

incident-bot: rollback initiated at 6223457020, job=rollback_wave4_112

cheng: rollback finished. verifying metrics: p95 steady ~140ms, throughput restored, kernel_fallback counts back to baseline.

oncall-1: handing off monitoring to oncall-2 for night watch — oncall-2 please ack and pick up postmortem tasks.

oncall-2: acked. will monitor dashboards, adding 1h runbook watch.

oncall-1: notes appended to runbook: root cause likely kernel-selector mismatch with fastpath-v2; plan: revert fastpath patch and add kernel compatibility test in CI, triage with runtime team tomorrow.

maria: tagging PM and release engineering for follow-up and scheduling rollback postmortem.

incident-bot: incident closed (S2). duration ~18m. summary: fastpath-v2 feature flip triggered kernel selection mismatch -> batching thrash -> p95 spike. Kill-switch + rollback mitigated.

oncall-2: adding postmortem checklist items to the handoff doc.

oncall-1: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
